title: Static Blog with getStaticProps
description: Fetch posts from an API at build time and display them on a page.
problemStatement:
## Goal
Build a page that lists blog posts fetched from JSONPlaceholder at build time.

### Requirements
1. Create a new page at `pages/posts.js`.
2. Export a default component that receives `posts` as a prop and renders an unordered list (`<ul>`) of post titles.
3. Export an `async function getStaticProps()` that:
   - Fetches `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts`
   - Returns `{ props: { posts } }` where `posts` is the array from the API.
4. Verify the page displays a list of 100 titles when running `npm run build` and `npm start` (or `npm run dev`).

### Bonus
- Add a link from the homepage (`/`) to `/posts`.
hints: Use `fetch` inside `getStaticProps`. Since it runs on the server, you don't need a full URL with domain; you can also just use an external one like the placeholder.
Don't forget to return an object with `props`.

The component should map over the array and render `
  • {post.title}
    • `.
expectedOutput: A page at `/posts` listing 100 post titles. When viewing the page source, the HTML should contain the titles (pre‑rendered).
